service_boundary: Represents Qianfan ModelBuilder, not the ERNIE model family, consumer chat products, Qianfan AppBuilder, or generic Baidu AI APIs.
regional_controls: International and mainland-China service paths and terms differ; endpoint and deployment availability must be verified for the selected Baidu Cloud region.
retention_controls: The Qianfan user agreement and applicable Baidu Cloud policies govern platform data; model, training, and deployed-service paths have distinct storage behavior.
routing: The platform exposes multiple models and deployment options but is not documented here as an automatic price- or latency-based upstream router.
customization: Qianfan supports data management, training, tuning, model management, and cloud deployment of inference services.
strengths: Combines Baidu's first-party models with third-party and open-model services.
Provides an end-to-end enterprise model development and serving path.
tradeoffs: International and mainland service boundaries differ.
Most detailed operational documentation is Chinese-language and feature-specific.

response_integrity.note: No signature, attestation, or equivalent mechanism for verifying that a response arrived unaltered from the model appears in the API reference or the security documentation.
response_integrity.scope: Qianfan ModelBuilder platform documentation, for Baidu Qianfan ModelBuilder

upstream_disclosure.note: No page found states whether prompt content is shared with third-party model publishers hosted on the platform, or is retained only by Baidu; the platform's user agreement addresses billing and acceptable use, not data flow to model providers.
upstream_disclosure.scope: Qianfan ModelBuilder platform user agreement, read for Baidu Qianfan ModelBuilder

credential_handling.note: The platform offers no customer-supplied-key path: every request is authenticated with a Baidu AI Cloud Access Key / Secret Access Key pair issued by the platform, computed into a signature rather than sent as a bearer token from a third party.
credential_handling.scope: Baidu AI Cloud signature-authentication reference, for Baidu Qianfan ModelBuilder

cache_isolation.note: No prompt or context caching feature or scope is documented in the platform's public documentation.
cache_isolation.scope: Qianfan ModelBuilder platform documentation, for Baidu Qianfan ModelBuilder

vulnerability_disclosure.note: Baidu operates a company-wide security response centre at bsrc.baidu.com, but the site could not be read: a plain fetch and a rendered browser session both returned an empty page, so its stated scope could not be confirmed and it is not cited as evidence.
vulnerability_disclosure.scope: Baidu AI Cloud compliance page, read for Baidu Qianfan ModelBuilder

independent_audit.note: The Baidu AI Cloud compliance page lists company-wide certifications and does not name Qianfan ModelBuilder.
independent_audit.scope: Baidu AI Cloud compliance page, for Baidu Qianfan ModelBuilder
